nodes.label: Cofounder (CLAUDE.md project guide)
nodes.rationale: One founder runs a company through a hierarchy of AI agents in typed, threaded department channels without becoming the approval bottleneck; optimize for a demoable vertical slice over breadth.

nodes.label: Invariant: Agents never execute
nodes.rationale: Role agents only propose actions inside envelopes; only Convex executes (Nessie directly, connectors via the Executor).

nodes.label: Invariant: Budgets decremented inside the gate transaction
nodes.norm_label: invariant: budgets decremented inside the gate transaction
nodes.rationale: Never check a budget in one function and spend it in another (avoids races).

nodes.label: Invariant: Every agent message is validated
nodes.norm_label: invariant: every agent message is validated
nodes.rationale: Invalid envelope gets one repair request in the same thread, then an ISSUE to the manager.

nodes.label: Invariant: The gate is code
nodes.rationale: evaluateGate is one deterministic transactional Convex mutation; LLMs may produce labels as inputs but never the decision.

nodes.label: Invariant: Graph limits (hop limit 3, no self-role tasks, max 3 handoffs)
nodes.norm_label: invariant: graph limits (hop limit 3, no self-role tasks, max 3 handoffs)

nodes.label: Invariant: Only the Dispatcher triggers agents
nodes.norm_label: invariant: only the dispatcher triggers agents
nodes.rationale: Agents never address each other; every inter-agent message is a Convex record delivered by the Dispatcher as a new run.

nodes.rationale: Work one spec at a time, plan then build, verify external APIs before coding, keep the app runnable.

nodes.label: Budgets (company:refund daily, company:marketing weekly)

nodes.label: label_error -> labels:low_confidence

nodes.label: Standups (Convex cron)

Manager REPORT stored in its channel thread and shown on the Company page; proposed_actions go through label -> gate. Weekly memo: cron assigns Cofounder a weekly_review task stored in #leadership.

nodes.label: Gate order (first match decides)
